task_name: Find a user by email or login
description: Find or, Search for, an Okta user by email or login return the user's ID.
command:
"$OKTA_URL/api/v1/users?search=profile.login eq ${answer1} or profile.email eq ${answer1}" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; text=sys.stdin.read(); exec("try:
 data=json.loads(text)
 print(json.dumps({"id": data[0]["id"]} if isinstance(data, list) and data else {"error": "Not found"}))
except: print(json.dumps({"error": "Invalid response"}))")'
questions: What is the user's email or login to look it up?*
